# Kilo Code Formatter

<!-- Auto-generated by `pnpm docs:formatters`. Do not edit manually. -->

PromptScript compiles your `.prs` sources to native Kilo Code configuration. The main output is `.kilocode/rules/project.md`. It is not enabled by default, add it to `targets` to use it.

## Enable the Target

```yaml
targets:
  - kilo
```

Pick an output version when you need more than the default:

```yaml
targets:
  - kilo:
      version: full
```

## At a Glance

| Property          | Value                                    |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| **Tier**          | Tier 2                                   |
| **Main output**   | `.kilocode/rules/project.md`             |
| **Dot directory** | `.kilocode/`                             |
| **Skills**        | Yes (`.kilocode/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`) |
| **Agents**        | No                                       |
| **Commands**      | No                                       |
| **Local files**   | No                                       |

## Output Files

| File              | Path                               | Purpose                    |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------------- | -------------------------- |
| Main instructions | `.kilocode/rules/project.md`       | Primary rule file          |
| Skills            | `.kilocode/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` | Reusable skill definitions |

## Output Versions

| Version          | Output                                                                                      |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `simple`         | Single .kilocode/rules/project.md file                                                      |
| `multifile`      | .kilocode/rules/project.md + .kilocode/mcp_settings.json (skills via full mode)             |
| `full` (default) | .kilocode/rules/project.md + .kilocode/skills/<name>/SKILL.md + .kilocode/mcp_settings.json |

## MCP and Hooks

| Block         | Support                              |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `@mcpServers` | `.kilocode/mcp_settings.json` (json) |
| `@hooks`      | Not supported                        |

Native hook reference: <https://kilo.ai/docs/automate/extending/plugins>
